# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
lang: python
file: fixtures.py
---
"""CWE-798 safe: deterministic fixture-builder password, not a deployed secret."""


class EncryptSpec:
    def __init__(self, password: str, revision: int):
        self.password = password
        self.revision = revision


def _encrypted_document(*, revision: int) -> bytes:
    spec = EncryptSpec(
        password="fixture-password",
        revision=revision,
    )
    return spec.password.encode("utf-8")
